event.title: Implement GitHub issue #108 completely. The harness fetches it and parent #106.
event.head: 8e085054f1

decisions: Missing menu files use shipped layouts parsed once with a permissive catalog, so defaults stay silent even with NameCatalog.empty().
A failed menu or wiki page discards its collected per-key warnings and emits exactly one severe MENU_FALLBACK warning.
Known buttons inherit omitted slot/item values silently; explicitly invalid slots drop only that button.
Omitted sound blocks always stay silent rather than restoring the shipped sound; invalid present sounds warn and stay silent.
BukkitNameCatalog.soundExists uses Registry.SOUNDS, falling back to Sound enum keys only when the registry class cannot initialize without a real server.
A null button section is treated like an empty section so it inherits shipped slot/item values.

findings.issue: An inherited button slot is never checked against a shrunk page, so the button stays outside the page with no warning.

label.why: Its reproduction failed when the harness reran it on the branch; sent to the worker.
